title: APM / 트레이스 검색
description: 느린 루트 span에서 TraceId를 복사해 trace_id 변수에 넣으면 해당 트레이스의 span 트리(ParentSpanId 연결)를 확인

panels.title: 응답 시간 분포 (루트 span) — 점을 확대해 느린 요청 시점 확인

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS t, SpanName, Duration / 1000000 AS ms FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId = '' AND ServiceName = '${service}' AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY t LIMIT 5000

panels.title: 느린 트레이스 (루트 span, Duration 내림차순) — TraceId 클릭 시 아래 워터폴로 연결

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, TraceId, SpanName, ServiceName, round(Duration / 1e6, 1) AS duration_ms, StatusCode FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId = '' AND ServiceName = '${service}' AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT TraceId AS traceID, SpanId AS spanID, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID, ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS operationName, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Timestamp) AS startTime, Duration / 1000000 AS duration FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE TraceId = '${trace_id}' ORDER BY startTime LIMIT 200

panels.title: span 상세 — TraceId = $trace_id (Timestamp 순, ParentSpanId로 트리 연결)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, SpanId, ParentSpanId, SpanName, ServiceName, round(Duration / 1e6, 2) AS duration_ms, StatusCode, SpanKind FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE TraceId = '${trace_id}' ORDER BY Timestamp LIMIT 200

list.name: service
list.label: 서비스
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_traces ORDER BY ServiceName
